## createCodecClient() function

Create an app's client whose calls encode values, hand them to `transport`<!-- -->, and decode the results, and record it so references can be bound to it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function createCodecClient<Client, Resources extends ResourceTable>(
  app: AppContract<Client, Resources>,
  transport: ClientTransport
): Client & ClientBrand<Resources>
```

**Returns:**

Client &amp; ClientBrand&lt;Resources&gt;

The client the contract's `bind` builds on the runtime; every reference it decodes, or that [bindReference()](./contracts_client.bindreference.md) binds to it, resolves through that runtime.

## Exceptions

`InternalError` when the contract's `bind` returns a client that was already created over another runtime. Recording it again would make references bound to the earlier client resolve under this one's credential.
